quote: We are expecting China Harbour Engineering Company (CHEC) to give us a final handover of all the buildings by mid-March... The Morant Bay Urban Centre is being constructed at a cost of $6 billion by contractors CHEC. The 28-acre development comprises more than 400,000 square feet...
note: Opened Jamaica Information Service 31 Jan 2025 government English page; $6 billion = JMD (JIS domestic convention).
